thread:
Jordan Rivera: hi all, first week question — where are the canonical onboarding docs and team templates in Notion? i need edit on the new-hire checklist. who do i ask?

Priya Singh: welcome Jordan! the docs live in the Redwood Inference workspace under Company > Onboarding and Team Templates. link: https://redwood.in/notion/onboarding.

Tom Brooks: easiest path for edit perms is the docs-permissions form: https://redwood.in/forms/docs-perms. include the page URLs and "edit" rights. alternatively ping the page owner (listed at top of each page).

Jordan Rivera: thanks — i don't see the pages yet, i think SSO didn't add me properly.

Priya Singh: try logging out and back in to SSO, and check your invite email. if that fails, send a screenshot here and i'll add you manually to the "New hire checklist".

notion-bot: Ticket DOCS-789 created for Jordan Rivera requesting edit access on "New hire checklist". Owner: Tom Brooks. ETA: 1 business day.

Tom Brooks: added you as editor on New hire checklist and the "Team PR template". confirm you can edit?

Jordan Rivera: can edit now, thanks! also: are there fill-in templates for first-week goals?

Priya Singh: yes — see "First week goals (template)" under Onboarding. duplicate the page and move it to your private workspace to fill in.

Tom Brooks: also ping me tomorrow if you want a quick walkthrough of the docs structure.
